description: This bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," illustrates the number of factual errors made by three different question-answering systems—NoR QA (orange with grid pattern), OneR QA (red with dots), and IRCt QA (blue with diagonal stripes)—across three distinct datasets: HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The horizontal axis displays the three datasets in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, scaled linearly from 0 to 35 with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each dataset, there are three grouped bars, one for each system, showing the specific error count for that system on that dataset. In the HotpotQA group, the NoR QA system has 15 errors, OneR QA has 10, and IRCt QA has 5. In the MuSiQue group, NoR QA has 29 errors, OneR QA has 23, and IRCt QA has 14. In the IIRC group, NoR QA has 28 errors, OneR QA has 27, and IRCt QA has 15. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the datasets on the horizontal axis. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner that maps the colors and patterns to the respective QA systems.
